blocks.html:
This method defines the inverse of the [hasOne](/references/data-model/relationship-methods/hasone) or [hasMany](/references/data-model/relationship-methods/hasmany) relationship.

For example, a product "belongsTo" a store.

types.name: T
types.description:
The type of the entity builder passed as a first parameter. By default, it's
a function returning the related model.

types.name: entityBuilder
types.description: A function that returns the data model this model is related to.

children.name: mappedBy
children.description:
The name of the relationship as defined in the other
data model. This is only required by the `belongsTo` and `manyToMany`
relationship method.
